source.swatchHost: sherwin.scene7.com (the swatch image each published stain page serves)
source.method: Each published stain swatch image was sampled at the median of its inner 50% box. The stain hex in this file is that measured swatch color.
source.note: Code, name, and page URL are copied verbatim from the published stain listing pages. Sherwin-Williams does not publish a hex for a stain, so no hex is quoted as published.
